fusions.name: Gap in the Plates
fusions.desc: A bite through a gap in the target's plates that deals 28 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Between the Greaves
fusions.desc: You scurry between the legs of every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 7 damage to each with a 40% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Hollow Suit
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 18% for 10 seconds, skitters you 2 tiles from where you stood, and gives you 6% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Layer by Layer
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
